dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible torso from the mid-point toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median intensity, with a decrease in reflectance toward the posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Medium-frequency distribution of darker grey pixel clusters localized predominantly in the posterior third of the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient observed between the lighter anterior/mid-dorsal region and the darker posterior mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct cluster of high-contrast, dark-grey curvilinear marks located on the anterior dorsal surface, slightly right of the central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of dark, curved marks on the anterior dorsal plane, exhibiting a non-linear geometric pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'C' or hook-shaped high-contrast pigment disruption on the upper-right dorsal quadrant.
